description: This file contains unit tests for the block analysis module in PyTorch's inductor backend, focusing on pattern matching of affine and modular indexing expressions using sympy symbols and expressions.

classes.name: BlockAnalysisTest
classes.description: A unit test class for testing block pattern matching functions related to affine and modular indexing in a PyTorch inductor context.

methods.name: setUpClass(cls)
methods.description: Initializes a dummy graph to be used in test cases.

methods.name: test_affine_identity(self, stride: int, symbol: sympy.Symbol, expr: sympy.Expr)
methods.description: Tests matching of affine block expressions with identity pattern.

methods.name: test_mod_div_identity( self, dims: tuple[int], strides: tuple[int], symbol: sympy.Symbol, expr: sympy.Expr, )
methods.description: Tests matching of modular division expressions in block indices, ensuring correct identification of block dimensions and strides.

methods.name: test_subexpr_identity( self, symbol: sympy.Symbol, expr: sympy.Expr, subexpr: sympy.Expr, )
methods.description: Tests retrieval of subexpressions involving a particular sympy symbol within larger expressions.

methods.name: test_index_with_dynamic_shapes(self)
methods.description: Tests pattern matching on indices with symbolic dimensions, including dynamic shape variables.

ctags.name: test_affine_identity
ctags.pattern: /^    def test_affine_identity(self, stride: int, symbol: sympy.Symbol, expr: sympy.Expr):$/
ctags.signature: (self, stride: int, symbol: sympy.Symbol, expr: sympy.Expr)

ctags.name: test_mod_div_identity
ctags.signature: ( self, dims: tuple[int], strides: tuple[int], symbol: sympy.Symbol, expr: sympy.Expr, )

ctags.name: test_subexpr_identity
ctags.signature: ( self, symbol: sympy.Symbol, expr: sympy.Expr, subexpr: sympy.Expr, )
